snippet.title: Tache Noire - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Tache Noire is an exploration based survival horror game where you can explore every single house and building in any order you like. It tells the story of five friends getting together for a reunion in Lucenille. Any feedback about the trailer is appreciated. Please Wishlist the game.
